Plot a PEIMS money-flow diagram

txs_plot_peims_flow.Rd

Renders the edge list from txs_peims_flow() as a Sankey diagram in the style of an income-statement flow chart, using the ggsankey package (not on CRAN; install with remotes::install_github("davidsjoberg/ggsankey")). Returns a ggplot, so titles, themes, and ggsave() all work as usual.

Usage

txs_plot_peims_flow(
  flows,
  palette = NULL,
  unit = 10000,
  space = NULL,
  label_wrap = 16
)

Arguments

flows

A peims_flow tibble from txs_peims_flow().

palette

Optional named character vector of node colors, overriding the defaults (first- and last-axis nodes get color; middle-axis and balance nodes are neutral).

unit

Dollars per ribbon strand; flows are drawn in units of unit (ggsankey sizes flows by row count). The default 1e4 keeps rendering exact to the nearest $10,000.

space

Vertical gap between nodes, in units. Default scales with the total flow.

label_wrap

Width at which node labels wrap.

Value

A ggplot object.
